args.command:
PORT=3123 node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s -X POST --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Winter world" http://localhost:3123/books -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n"
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Left Hand of Darkness[^<]*' | head -1
ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '/books/[a-f0-9-]+' | head -1 | cut -d/ -f3)
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3123/books/$ID/finish" -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n"
curl -s "http://localhost:3123/books/$ID" | grep -oE '(currently reading|finished [0-9-]+)' | head -1
kill %1
PORT=3123 node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s "http://localhost:3123/books/$ID" | grep -c 'Left Hand of Darkness'
kill %1

events.content:
Done. Zero-dependency Node app — run it with `npm start` and open http://localhost:3000.

- `server.js` — home page lists currently reading / finished with an add-book form, `POST /books/:id/finish` marks done, and `GET /books/:id` is the shareable per-book page with title, author, notes
- `lib/store.js` — persists to `books.json` (verified surviving a restart)
- `test/` — 15 vitest tests, all passing (`npm test`)

`books.json` is gitignored since it's runtime data.
